assumptions.statement: The team prefers to keep the Terraform codebase simple rather than adopting more complex lifecycle management mechanisms like CloudFormation or multiple ASGs.
The operational overhead of manually terminating instances is acceptable for the frequency of Launch Configuration changes.
assumptions.quote: Dev time that involves changing the LC may slow slightly or require further automation to enable rapid work on instances

assumptions.statement: The system relies on the persistence of Auto Scaling Groups across Launch Configuration changes to maintain state or identity, which is a benefit of the chosen manual termination approach over creating new ASGs.
